fidelity: F2a -- Averaged State-Space Model with Parasitic Losses
description: State-space averaged ODE model of an isolated flyback converter. States: [i_m, v_C] (primary-referred magnetizing current, output capacitor voltage). Continuous-time averaged over one switching cycle (CCM). Galvanic isolation via transformer turns ratio n = N1/N2. Ideal gain V_out = (d/(1-d))*(V_in/n). Parasitic Rds_on, diode Vf and winding resistance give efficiency in (0,1).
source: Erickson & Maksimovic (2020), Fundamentals of Power Electronics, 3rd ed., Springer (Ch. 7 AC equivalent circuit modeling; Ch. 6 converter circuits / flyback)

unit.name: Generic 48V-to-12V Isolated Flyback Converter -- Averaged SSM
unit.source: Erickson & Maksimovic (2020), Fundamentals of Power Electronics, 3rd ed., Springer

n_turns.note: Turns ratio n = N1/N2 (primary/secondary). Reflected ratio i_m/n appears on secondary.
